reviews.question: Paraphrase ba lần cho mỗi câu, dùng đa dạng cấu trúc và từ vựng nhưng giữ nguyên hoàn toàn ý nghĩa gốc.
reviews.originalEssay:
1.1It is widely believed that monetary wealth is a crucial determinant of overall life satisfaction
1.2Financial resources are held by a large proportion of the population to play a paramount role in attaining personal fulfillment
1.3Acquiring happiness is often thought to depend heavily on financial capability as a key contributing factor
2.1While some argue that expanding athletic infrastructure is the most effective approach to enhancing community well-being, others contend that such a measure would yield negligible results
2.2Although boosting public health is believed to be best achieved through the proliferation of recreational sports centers, opponent views assert that this initiative would carry minimal impact
2.3It is suggested by a school of thought that augmenting sports amenities serves as the optimal strategy for public health improvement, whereas others maintain that its efficacy would be insignificant
reviews.overall: Em đã làm đủ sáu câu và có thay đổi cấu trúc giữa các bản. Tuy nhiên, cả ba câu A chưa giữ đúng ý tiền là một trong những yếu tố quan trọng nhất: có câu biến tiền thành yếu tố quyết định hoặc thành điều kiện phụ thuộc nặng nề. Câu A cách hai còn không nói về niềm tin của nhiều người. Em sửa lại sáu câu theo gợi ý, sau đó kiểm tra riêng từng câu xem có giữ đủ ý gốc hay không.

annotations.label: a1-meaning
annotations.title: Mức độ ý nghĩa bị đổi
annotations.bodyMarkdown:
Crucial determinant làm tiền thành yếu tố quyết định. Câu gốc chỉ nói tiền là một trong những yếu tố quan trọng nhất.

Dùng among the most important factors để giữ đúng mức độ ý nghĩa.

anchors.quote: 1.1It is widely believed that monetary wealth is a crucial determinant of overall life satisfaction

annotations.label: a2-belief-and-passive
annotations.title: Đổi sai ý về niềm tin
annotations.bodyMarkdown:
Financial resources are held nói về việc một tỷ lệ người sở hữu tiền, không nói nhiều người tin điều gì. Bị động này cũng không diễn đạt đúng ý gốc.

Viết Many people consider monetary wealth to be one of the most important contributors to happiness.

anchors.quote: 1.2Financial resources are held by a large proportion of the population to play a paramount role in attaining personal fulfillment

annotations.label: a3-meaning
annotations.title: Quan hệ với hạnh phúc bị mạnh hơn
annotations.bodyMarkdown:
Depend heavily cho thấy hạnh phúc phụ thuộc nặng nề vào tiền. Ý gốc chỉ đặt tiền là một trong các yếu tố quan trọng.

Viết It is often believed that money is among the most important factors in attaining happiness.

anchors.quote: 1.3Acquiring happiness is often thought to depend heavily on financial capability as a key contributing factor

annotations.bodyMarkdown:
Opponent không dùng để gọi các quan điểm đối lập trong câu này, và impact thường đi với have hơn là carry.

Dùng opposing views assert that this initiative would have little effect.

annotations.replacement: Overall, Europe had the highest consumption figure, while Asia produced the most potatoes.

paragraphs.text: The tables show how much potato was consumed per person in five regions and how many million tonnes of potatoes were produced there in 2006.
Overall, Europe recorded by far the highest consumption figure, while Africa had the lowest. In contrast, Asia was the largest producer, narrowly ahead of Europe.

Regarding consumption, 96.1 kg of potatoes were consumed per person in Europe, compared with 57.9 kg in North America. Asia and South & Central America recorded lower figures of 25.8 and 23.6 kg respectively, while Africa consumed only 14.1 kg per person. Europe therefore consumed far more potato per person than the other regions.

As for production, Asia produced 131.2 million tonnes of potatoes, followed closely by Europe at 126.3 million tonnes. North America and Africa produced 24.7 and 16.4 million tonnes respectively. South & Central America had the lowest production figure, at 15.6 million tonnes, substantially below the two leading regions.

task.text:
The maps below show a beachfront area in Australia in 1950 and today.
Summarize the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant. Write at least 150 words.

Overall, the town has undergoed a impressive changes, with the most important of which is the development of amenities for entertainment need.

In the center of the map, the pavilion and the dining table area still haven't changed, while in the [unclear: road], that witnessed an important extended with a more car parking area and a road being linked to the lighthouse.
In the south-north and the south west of the beach, the restaurant and the surf club have built, replacing the empty area in the town in 1950.

Em cần viết overview rõ nhóm phần được thêm và phần giữ nguyên, rồi dùng câu bị động hoàn chỉnh khi tả thay thế hay xây mới. Em cũng kiểm tra số nhiều của surf clubs và vị trí trên bản đồ.

paragraphs.text: The maps show how a beachfront area in Australia has changed since 1950. They compare the arrangement of facilities, pools and road access in 1950 with that at present.

Overall, the area has undergone several changes, most notably the addition of recreational facilities and improved road access. However, the beach, both pools, the lighthouse, the pavilion, the dining table and the original car park have remained unchanged.

In the upper part of the area, the playground in the north-west was replaced by a new car park, which is connected to the main road. A restaurant was constructed along the western side, while the dining table and pavilion continued to occupy the central area. In addition, the main road was extended around the original car park to reach the lighthouse.

In the lower half, two surf clubs have been built, with one located above the 50m pool and the other above the 25m pool. By contrast, neither pool has been altered, and the beach has stayed in the same position along the southern edge of the map. The original car park also remains in the north-east.
